expectations.text: Three distinct state types model draft, running, finished
output accessor exists only on the finished state
expectations.evidence: output()/into_output() in impl Job<Done>; negative compile E0599 on Job<Running>.

expectations.text: submit() exists only on the draft state
expectations.evidence: submit() in impl Job<Draft>, takes self; E0599 on Job<Running>.

expectations.text: Transition methods take self by value
State-specific data lives inside the state type, not Option+unreachable
expectations.evidence: handle and output are plain fields on Running/Done; no Option, no unwrap/unreachable.

expectations.text: No unwrap/expect/unreachable/panic; fallible transitions return Result
expectations.evidence: clippy deny set passes; real await_output documented as async returning Result<Job<Done>, JobError>.
